body: A multiplayer-focused Minecraft Cobblemon modpack designed to expand the Pokémon-inspired experience with enhanced exploration, performance improvements, quality-of-life features, and additional gameplay content. The modpack combines Cobblemon with carefully selected supporting mods to create a balanced and immersive multiplayer environment, including improved world generation, building tools, server utilities, optimization mods, and social features. It is intended for long-term survival gameplay with friends, community interaction, adventure, trading, battles, and cooperative progression while maintaining stable performance and compatibility.
